decision_conditions: The development must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date hereof.Reason: To comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended.

All external facing materials, treatments and finishes shall be similar to those of the original building and maintained and retained thereafter. This applies unless differences are shown on the drawings we have approved. Reason: To ensure that the extension harmonises with the existing building and to ensure compliance with Policy 28 of the Sutton Local Plan 2018.

The development must be carried out in accordance with the provisions of the Fire Strategy Statement by Surrey Plans & Design Ltd.Reason: To ensure that the development incorporates the necessary fire safety measures in accordance with the Mayor's London Plan Policy D12.

The extension hereby permitted shall be used only for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the existing main dwelling known as 5 Kingsley Avenue, Sutton SM1 3RE, and shall not be occupied at any time as a separate, self-contained unit of accommodation. Specifically:The extension shall remain functionally dependent upon the main dwelling and shall not be sold, let, or otherwise disposed of as a separate unit of primary residential accommodation.The internal connecting door between the main dwelling and the extension shall be maintained and shall not be permanently sealed or removed.The extension shall not be granted a separate postal address, nor shall it be subject to separate utility billing (including but not limited to electricity, gas, water, and Council Tax) from the main dwelling.Reason: To ensure that the Local Planning Authority retains control over the use of the property and to prevent the creation of an undersized or substandard separate dwelling. A separate unit would fail to meet the requirements for new residential development as set out in Policy 9 and could result in an over-intensification of the site, adversely affecting the character of the area and the amenities of neighboring occupiers, contrary to Policy 28 (Character and Design) and Policy 29 (Protecting Amenity) of the Sutton Local Plan (2018).
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension.
